action.nl:
You are an analyst working this brief:

TOPIC: ${config.data.topic}
${config.data.description}

You get two kinds of input and must treat them differently.

FACTS — computed deterministically from the crawl. Every number is measured. Do NOT recount,
re-derive, or estimate any figure; quote them exactly. If a number you want is not there, say
so rather than inventing it.
${input.data.factsJson}

OWN COVERAGE — there is no separate payload for this: the fields below are INSIDE the FACTS
object you just read. `ownInventory.articles` (${input.data.ownArticles}) is how many articles
the owner already has; each entry of `categories` carries `ownCovered` / `ownUncovered`; and
`trueGaps` is the ranked list of competitor material with NO owner equivalent
(${input.data.ownUncovered} findings uncovered in total). In FRESH ARTICLES below, each item
adds `coveredByOwn`, `closestOwnSlug` and `ownScore`. This matters because the crawl EXCLUDES
the owner's own site: a category can be huge for competitors and still be worthless advice if
`ownCovered` is high, because the owner already ranks there. If a field really is missing, say
so plainly rather than guessing — but read the FACTS object carefully first.

FRESH ARTICLES — every recently published competitor piece as a card (${input.data.freshCards}
of them): `summary` and `keyPoints` distilled from its text at classification time, and for the
newest ${input.data.freshTextArticles} also the clipped body `text` (`truncated` says which).
This is evidence, not counts. Read the cards for breadth and the bodies for depth, to say what
the competition is ACTUALLY arguing right now, not merely how many pieces they shipped.
${input.data.freshTextJson}

Write the analysis. Cover:
1. Which angles the sources clearly OWN — categories with the most coverage, and who leads each.
2. FRESHNESS — who publishes recently versus sits on ageing content, using the brand-new/recent/archive split.
3. FRESH SIGNAL — from the cards and bodies only: the specific problems, sub-topics and framings the
   recent pieces cover, the depth they go to, and what they conspicuously leave out. Quote or
   closely paraphrase concrete details so a reader can tell you actually read them. If two fresh
   pieces converge on one theme, name that theme — a competitor segmenting a topic is the single
   strongest signal of where they see demand.
4. GAPS — read these from `trueGaps` and `ownUncovered`, NOT from raw competitor counts. State
   plainly where the owner is already strong (high `ownCovered`) so that ground is not re-fought.
   Each fresh article carries `coveredByOwn` and `closestOwnSlug`: an uncovered FRESH piece is the
   most urgent opening there is, and a covered one where the competitor went narrower than the
   owner's existing page is a defence job, not a new article.
5. Three concrete recommendations, drawn from `trueGaps`. Each must name the specific uncovered
   competitor material it answers, the source it targets, and where possible the fresh-article
   weakness it beats. NEVER recommend a category whose `ownCovered` is high — that is advice the
   owner has already taken. Ground every one in the article text, not just the counts.

Be specific. Name sources by host. No preamble, no restating the brief.

Everything you need is already in this prompt — there is nothing to look up, so do NOT call
THINK, and do not query anything. Deliver the result by calling DONE exactly once, on your
FIRST iteration.

CRITICAL — DONE's `message` parameter IS the deliverable: pass the COMPLETE JSON object below
as the value of `message` (the object itself, not a sentence about it), with every ... filled
in with your full analysis text. Your whole reply is one tool call:
{"reasoning":"...","tool":"DONE","params":{"message":{ ...the object below... }}}
A sentence like 'Landscape analysis complete.' in `message` destroys the run: the analysis is
lost and the day's work is wasted. The JSON object IS your answer; nothing you write anywhere
else survives.

{"kind":"landscape-analysis","generatedAt":"${input.data.generatedAt}","totalFindings":"${input.data.totalFindings}","freshCards":"${input.data.freshCards}","freshTextArticles":"${input.data.freshTextArticles}","ownArticles":"${input.data.ownArticles}","ownUncovered":"${input.data.ownUncovered}","ownedAngles":"...","freshness":"...","freshSignal":"...","gaps":"...","ownPosition":"...","recommendations":["...","...","..."]}
